notes.title: Astrologaster Update v1.5 and minimum requirements
notes.notes:
Small update this week, to fix 2 achievements still not unlocking reliably for everyone. The achievements 'Astrologaster' and 'Simon Forman' should now unlock for everyone. 

After recieving a number of support requests from people with older machines we had another look at what the minimum requirements should be and have updated these now. 

[b]Windows - Minimum requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]     OS: Windows 7/8
[*]     Processor: Intel i3/i5/i7 dual core or equivalent
[*]     Memory: 4 GB RAM
[*]     Graphics: Open GL 2.1 compatible card
[*]     Storage: 2 GB available space
[*]     Sound Card: Yes
[/list]

[b]Mac - Minimum requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]     OS: macOS 10.12 - Sierra
[*]     Memory: 4 GB RAM
[*]     Graphics: Open GL 2.1 compatible card
[*]     Storage: 700 MB available space
[*]     Sound Card: Yes
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33063242/d188c9b4744731bd1e167f6596171074ef170695.jpg[/img]

It is E3 week. What games are you most excited for?

notes.notes:
Version 1.4 of Astrologaster is now available on Steam.

[Fixed]

[*] Bug preventing 2 achievements from being unlocked. The achievements affected were "Simon Forman" and "Astrologaster".
[*] Rare bug making it impossible to continue the game after Emilia Lanier's last consultation.

notes.title: Astrologaster Update v1.3
notes.notes:
Version 1.3 of Astrologaster is now live  Steam. 

[New] Added 25 achievements
[New] Added an "About" section to the the title menu
[New] Added a way to read up on a patient's history during a consultation
[Fixed] Incorrectly assigned planetary dignities. 

Please report any issues you might encounter in the forum or by emailing: contact@nyamyam.com

If you enjoy Astrologaster, please leave a review. Have a  great weekend!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31498868/51b8311d4375b7ba2c979a78657d21932c7ea6cc.gif[/img]

notes.title: Astrologaster Update v1.2
notes.notes:
We just uploaded version 1.2 of Astrologaster to Steam. 

[i]Fixes/Improvements[/i]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Missing audio files for Alice Blague and John Whitgift 
[*]Fixed: Repeating dialogue in John Whitgift
[*]Fixed: Logic bug in Emma Sharpe's storyline that could result in ignoring a player's choice
[*]Fixed: Rare bug which could make it impossible to play the last consultation. 
[*]Improvement: Added a pause/play button to cut scenes.
[/list]

Please report any issues you might encounter in the forum or by emailing: contact@nyamyam.com


[b]Many thanks to everyone who took the time so far to review Astrologaster. We could always use more![/b]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33063242/2063f4ad28efdd37aa2eb1f2ad18b4a457dbfa58.gif[/img]
